claim_summary: The regular rhombic dodecahedron has brightness 4(2a+b) in sorted absolute coordinates, exact full CDF by a single algebraic integral, exact linear upper tail to 6sqrt(2), an onset correction of order 3/2 with explicit coefficient, and quadratic lower tail with coefficient sqrt(3)/(8pi).
limitations: Fixed regular Euclidean rhombic dodecahedron; no arbitrary affine deformation law.
The global CDF is a one-dimensional algebraic integral, not an elementary antiderivative.
First-overlap asymptotics do not classify later spherical-cap overlaps.
Historical priority remains provisional; a possibly relevant recent broad density paper was not available in full text.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with explicit normalization and a separate deterministic finite diagnostic checker; no formal or independent certification.
title: Exact random-shadow law and first spherical-cap contact for the rhombic dodecahedron
